scope: Proposition 3.7 (Uniform success at a seam) of the manuscript “Brownian continuum random tree limits of finite Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps above four” (preprints/Brownian-continuum-random-tree-limits-of-finite-Fortuin-Kasteleyn-maps-above-four-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0d730ea9a40f1505), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is δ > 0, depending only on p, such that for every integer h ≥ 1 the seam interval formed by the backwards hit of +h and the forwards hit of −h reduces to the empty word with probability at least δ.
